connects_to.relationship: AWS cloud hosting of BillionToOne's QCT test algorithms, bioinformatics platform and data center

contracts.signal: 10-K supplier disclosure: BillionToOne maintains a data center within Amazon Web Services (AWS); it hosts the significant majority of its proprietary QCT algorithms, a crucial component of its test processing, on a cloud-based software platform under an agreement with AWS, and its bioinformatics platform runs on third-party data center hosting facilities operated by AWS. It has no backup platform, server or other means to host the algorithms.
